basic_info.description: Discover the perfect blend of historic charm and modern comfort at the Hale Warehouse, a landmark in downtown San Francisco's vibrant Mint Plaza. This 10-story building, designed by the Reid Brothers in 1926, offers a unique living experience that seamlessly merges the building's rich history with contemporary design. This 2BR/2BA loft-style unit in the Mint Collection combines industrial style with premium amenities. The unit boasts an open floor plan with acid-stained concrete floors, soaring 11'6'' ceilings, and large warehouse-style windows. Enjoy central AC/Heating, a LATCH keyless entry system, and designer kitchens and baths. Located in San Francisco's bustling SOMA District, it's just a block from public transit (BART, MUNI, Cable Cars), the new Saluhall Food Space which features top food vendors, as well as 2 bars, a bakery, a cooking school and more. Within blocks of Trader Joe's, Target, The Metreon, Yerba Buena Gardens and Union Square. Building amenities include concierge services, a fitness center, and a rooftop deck with BBQ, lounge chairs, hot tub and stunning city views. The Hale Warehouse is more than just a place to liveit's a piece of San Francisco's heritage.
